quote: We investigate several models from the BERT family ... tasks: part-of-speech tagging, dependency head prediction, preposition supersense role & function prediction and text classification.
We report the average accuracy and its standard deviation for each classifier, focusing on classification performance rather than generated text.
All fine‑tuning and probing steps use standard optimization and probing methods without employing language models as post‑generation judges.
Evaluation relies on classifier accuracy and probing analyses; no human annotators or crowdsourcing are used to assess generated outputs.
